blurb: Guests join tours to see whales, porpoises, sea lions, eagles, and other wildlife in the Salish Sea. Tours range from 3-4 hours to full day adventures including a stop in Friday Harbor. Two boats are used: a zodiac-style vessel for up to 17 passengers and a semi-covered boat for up to 6 guests.
